name: How long does a typical shower installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical shower installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a shower installation varies depending on the project's complexity. A straightforward replacement of an existing shower unit might take 1-2 days. However, more involved projects, such as converting a bathtub into a shower, installing a custom walk-in shower, or those requiring significant plumbing modifications or tiling work, could take 3-5 days or longer. We aim to complete installations efficiently while ensuring quality. Our team in areas like Avondale and Surprise will provide an estimated timeline during your initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: A basic shower replacement can take 1-2 days, while more complex installations, like conversions or custom designs, may require 3-5 days or more.
